item.title: How consistency quietly builds confidence you can trust
item.description: Learn how consistency strengthens self-trust and confidence over time, turning small daily actions into reliable belief in yourself.

item.title: Urban Company and the trust-first playbook for services
item.description: How Urban Company solved fraud, safety and pricing fears to build trust in India’s home services market through verification, training and accountability.

item.title: AI is infrastructure, and India will have its own,” says NVIDIA's Jensen Huang
item.description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said India will build its own AI systems, data centres and chips, calling artificial intelligence as essential to nations as electricity and the internet.

item.title: This startup is bringing the benefits of AI to retail stock market investors
item.description: Mumbai-based InvestorAi has built its own specialised AI stock picking platform to help retail investors navigate through the turbulent world of markets.

item.title: Unicorn India Ventures raises Rs 1,200 Cr in final close of Fund III
item.description: The fund was launched in 2023 with a target corpus of Rs 1,000 crore and a greenshoe of Rs 200 crore.

item.title: Alphabet caps 2025 with revenue milestone, doubles down on AI spending
item.description: For the full financial year, Alphabet reported revenue of $402.8 billion, up 15% year on year, while net profit for FY25 rose 32% to $132.2 billion.

item.title: From K-dramas to coffee culture: How Monika Alcobev is betting on trends before the hype
item.description: After importing 100% agave tequila since 2018, Monika Alcobev is now betting big on Korean soju and Spanish liqueur.

item.title: Fashion quick-commerce startup ZILO raises $15.3M in Series A round led by Peak XV Partners
item.description: The funding will support expansion beyond Mumbai over the next year, technology upgrades, and customer experience capabilities.

item.title: Golden Sparrow Ventures raises $20M in first close of Fund II
item.description: The US-structured VC firm noted that it has received over half of the fund’s commitments and intends to back 22 companies at pre-seed and seed stage.

item.title: Amazon expands Amit Agarwal’s role to lead global selling partner services
item.description: Agarwal, currently Senior Vice President for International Emerging Stores, will continue to oversee Amazon’s marketplace operations across a group of high-growth countries while taking on leadership of SPS.
